channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: WHO chief warns Ebola response must ramp up to stem DRC outbreak
item.description: Number of people killed in the Democratic Republic of Congo from disease exceeds 3,000 amid response funding gap.

item.title: China’s Xi urges new Middle East security framework during rare Egypt visit
item.description: Chinese, Egyptian leaders discuss the US-Israel war on Iran, which has prompted regional powers to rethink defence.

item.title: Aubameyang ‘humiliated’ as ex-Arsenal striker quits Gabon national team
item.description: Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang cites 2025 Africa Cup of Nations treatment as captain steps away from Gabon duty.

item.title: Putin and Zelenskyy issue threats as strikes rock Ukraine, Russia
item.description: Putin accuses Zelenskyy of 'terrorism', while Ukraine warns foreign airlines against using Russian airspace.

item.title: What is Iran’s Castle Breaker missile, used against US bases?
item.description: Kheibar Shekan, Iran's medium-range missile, is said to play a pivotal role in escalating US-Israel tensions.

item.title: The US is gobbling up Venezuelan oil, but will it lower fuel prices?
item.description: Analysts say Venezuelan crude is hard to extract and refine, and likely can't replace oil stuck in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: What do we know about the fatal US bombing of a wedding in Iran’s Sirik?
item.description: A residential building and a telecom tower were struck overnight, as Iran and the US launched more strikes over Hormuz.

item.title: Iran says US strike killed four at wedding in 'war crime' as US denies targeting civilians
item.description: Iranian media reports two children were among those killed when shrapnel hit a home. Iran then launched missiles and drones at US targets in the Middle East.

item.title: More than 900 killed in Gaza this year despite ceasefire, Hamas-run health ministry says
item.description: The ministry says the total number of people killed in the Strip since 10 October is now more than 1,300, including 301 children.

item.title: What we know about reported strike on Iran wedding celebrations
item.description: BBC Verify looks at footage showing the aftermath of a strike on a building in southern Iran.
